description: A Java class implementing a custom TextToSpeechService for generating robot-like speech audio using frequency mappings per character, supporting multiple languages and integrating with Android's TTS API.

classes.name: RobotSpeakTtsService
classes.description: A custom TextToSpeechService that synthesizes robot-like speech based on character frequency mappings, supporting language loading, synthesis, and stop control.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes shared preferences and loads default language.

methods.name: onIsLanguageAvailable
methods.description: Checks if a language/country/variant combination is supported.

methods.name: onLoadLanguage
methods.description: Loads language data and frequency map from assets.

methods.name: onSynthesizeText
methods.description: Synthesizes speech audio from text request, character by character.

methods.name: buildFrequencyMap
methods.description: Builds a frequency map from input stream data.

methods.name: generateOneSecondOfAudio
methods.description: Generates one second of audio for a character based on its frequency.

methods.name: getAmplitude
methods.description: Returns amplitude value based on whisper setting.
